actual_primary_edition.title: Forms representing forms: The definite case
actual_primary_edition.author: Julia Brandes

critical_precursor_interface.pages1_2: Positive definite integral forms and representations; J defined modulo ordering; pseudo-diagonal terminology introduced, higher-degree characterization discussed. This is direct precursor context, not the new proof dependency.
critical_precursor_interface.page5: Unit diagonal scaling discussion eq2.1 and Lemma2.1: every positive definite quadratic form is pseudo-diagonal.
critical_precursor_interface.page6: Actual proof gives the usual symmetric-matrix absolute bound |b_ij|<=sqrt(b_i*b_j) by testing lambda*e_i plus/minus mu*e_j.
critical_precursor_interface.coefficient_normalization_limit: The v2 introduction uses J disregarding order while Lemma2.1 is stated/proved in matrix-entry convention. No identification of its n_j with canonically ordered d-linear entries across conventions/editions is silently made. The target paper explicitly fixes its own ordered convention, and its central theorem/proof does not invoke the precursor counting theorem.
critical_precursor_interface.scope_not_inherited: The precursor counting theorems concern integral forms, local representations and sufficiently many variables. None of these are a hidden hypothesis in the target real-GL existence proof.

priority_reading_boundary: Two actual focused antecedent interfaces read. No comprehensive literature audit, global absence proof, priority certification or external peer review performed.
